title: Wellness
seoDescription: The studio lounge, physiotherapist-led workshops, community classes, and programs for schools, sporting clubs and workplaces.

blocks.title: Wellness
blocks.quote: More than a place to exercise.
blocks.intro: The space, workshops, community, and programs for schools, clubs and workplaces.

blocks.text: A welcoming space to slow down, reconnect and invest in yourself. Where movement, care and community become a natural part of everyday life.

tile.caption: Arrival, Mosman Park
tile.description: Arrive, settle in and take a moment before you move.

blocks.heading: A new space for wellbeing.
paragraphs: Inspired by the natural warmth and relaxed rhythm of coastal Western Australia, our space has been thoughtfully designed to balance movement with moments of pause.

Natural materials, warm textures and considered details create an environment that feels as welcoming as it is restorative. A place where the experience of arriving, moving and spending time matters just as much as the care you receive.

items.title: Workshops
items.body: Small-group education sessions led by our physiotherapists, on topics like preparing your body for birth and planning the first weeks at home. Partners and family are welcome.

items.title: Community
items.body: Classes, groups and gatherings that bring people together around movement, from postnatal classes where babies are welcome to events in the studio.

items.title: A Place to Pause
items.body: A lounge to arrive early, stay a while after class, or simply sit for a moment before the rest of your day.

blocks.heading: Beyond the studio
blocks.intro: Physiotherapy-led programs for the places people learn, play and work, arranged directly with each school, club or workplace.

items.title: Schools
items.body: Pelvic health and movement education for Years 7 to 12, covering growing bodies, the menstrual cycle, injury prevention in sport and how to navigate healthcare.

items.title: Sporting Clubs
items.body: Pre-season screening, education for players and coaches, and injury management through the season.

items.title: Workplaces
items.body: Workplace movement assessments and programs for teams, run on site or at the studio.
